CREATE PROCEDURE DW.HIST_SP_DW_DIMRISKRATINGTYPE
AS
BEGIN

WITH DIMRISKRATINGTYPE AS 
(
SELECT
	BRR.RISKRATINGTYPEID AS RiskRatingTypeID
	,BRR.RiskRatingTypeName AS RiskRatingTypeName
	,NULL AS RiskRatingTypeDescription
	,DDB.BANKSK AS BankSK
	,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
	,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
	,BRR.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.RiskRatingType BRR
LEFT JOIN DW.DIMBANK DDB ON BRR.FinancialInstitutionId = DDB.BANKID
WHERE BRR.SOURCESYSTEMCODE = 'CRM'

UNION ALL

SELECT
	'TU Score' AS RiskRatingTypeID
	,'TU Score' AS RiskRatingTypeName
	,NULL AS RiskRatingTypeDescription
	,DDB.BANKSK AS BankSK
	,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
	,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
	,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
FROM DW.DIMBANK DDB
WHERE DDB.BANKid = 'CBC01'

UNION ALL

SELECT
	'ECRAF' AS RiskRatingTypeID
	,'ECRAF' AS RiskRatingTypeName
	,NULL AS RiskRatingTypeDescription
	,DDB.BANKSK AS BankSK
	,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
	,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
	,'SEC' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
FROM DW.DimBank DDB
WHERE DDB.BANKid = 'CBC11'
),

RISKRATINGTYPE_SK AS(SELECT ISNULL(MAX(RiskRatingTypeSK),0) RN FROM DW.DIMRISKRATINGTYPE),

TEMP_DW_DIMRISKRATINGTYPE AS 
(
	SELECT 
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM RISKRATINGTYPE_SK) AS RiskRatingTypeSK
		,RiskRatingTypeID
		,RiskRatingTypeName
		,RiskRatingTypeDescription
		,BankSK
		,ValidStartDate
		,convert(date,ValidEndDate) AS ValidEndDate
		,SourceSystemCode
		,WorkFlowId
		,TaskRunId
		,InsertDttm
	FROM DIMRISKRATINGTYPE
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_DW_DIMRISKRATINGTYPE FROM TEMP_DW_DIMRISKRATINGTYPE;


INSERT INTO  DW.DimRiskRatingType
	(RiskRatingTypeSK
	,RiskRatingTypeID
	,RiskRatingTypeName
	,RiskRatingTypeDescription
	,BankSK
	,ValidStartDate
	,ValidEndDate
	,SourceSystemCode
	,WorkFlowId
	,TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm)
SELECT
	RiskRatingTypeSK
	,SRC.RiskRatingTypeID
	,RiskRatingTypeName
	,RiskRatingTypeDescription
	,SRC.BankSK
	,ValidStartDate
	,ValidEndDate
	,SourceSystemCode
	,WorkFlowId
	,TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_DW_DIMRISKRATINGTYPE SRC

END
